context_evidence.use: PayloadHeader derives Serialize/Deserialize and owns schema_id: SchemaId and schema_version; header decode is the deserialization caller context.
Text inspection first borrows the raw envelope/payload and then strictly decodes PayloadHeader; header SchemaId ownership is separate from the borrowed payload.

Public versioned loading routes text to load_text_versioned; envelope schema/version are validated before old payload becomes Value; load_migrated_value then runs the chain and decodes the target type.
migrate_value validates the complete target chain and invokes each step for from_version..target_version; input 1/target 2 invokes fixture step 1.
The fixture chain must have every adjacent step from version 0 through target 2; this validation occurs before invoking the selected migration callback.
dev profile has no overflow-check override; test profile lines 82-84 likewise do not override it; shipping separately sets overflow-checks=false and is not the test-only fixture path.

parse_integer keeps positive integer significands in u64 until actual overflow; parse_number emits ParserNumber::U64 for a positive integer, so the exact maximum is representable as an unsigned JSON integer.
Number::as_u64 returns the positive-integer u64 value; u64::MAX therefore passes the fixture helper's as_u64 guard.

Official Cargo profile documentation: test inherits dev; dev defaults overflow-checks to true. The repository test profile does not override this. This supports the conditional test-build panic claim.

direct_contract_path: SchemaId is re-exported by serialization/mod.rs and is the owned PayloadHeader.schema_id field.
text/read.rs owns the parsed header while retaining payload as borrowed RawValue; load.rs compares header schema to T::SCHEMA and checks the source version before migration.
VersionedSchema is consumed by text/binary loaders through SCHEMA, VERSION and migrations(); migration execution returns JSON Value before the target type is constructed.
calls_traits_registration.serde_and_lifetime: SchemaId derives transparent Serialize and manually Deserialize; static construction borrows static input while dynamic TryFrom/Deserialize values own text. PayloadHeader derives serde traits. No unsafe block is in the five formal files.
calls_traits_registration.macro_ffi_dynamic_registration: The formal files use serde derives/attributes only; no macro_rules or VersionedSchema code-generation macro, FFI declaration/call or dynamic registration entry is present. Search covered all five formal files and their serialization module/loader caller context.

issues.scope: Private shared serialization test fixture migration helper only; this is not a claim about product migration implementations or all release profiles.
issues.trigger: A versioned text envelope with schema zircon.tests.fixture-document, schema_version 1, and an object count exactly u64::MAX reaches load_text_versioned in a test build with overflow checks enabled.
path: FixtureDocument declares VERSION=2 and migration steps 0 and 1 at tests/mod.rs:37-49.
load.rs checks schema and source version before parsing an older payload into serde_json::Value; load_migrated_value calls migrate_value before serde_json::from_value constructs FixtureDocument.
migrate_value validates the complete chain and iterates from_version..target_version; 1..2 invokes the v1 helper once.
serde_json 1.0.151 accepts u64::MAX as a positive u64 Number and Number::as_u64 returns it, so the helper guard succeeds.
count + 1 overflows before the callback returns; with test-profile overflow checks, the panic precedes MigrateError/LoadError return and target u32 decode.
issues.observable_effect: The test loader panics at the helper addition rather than returning a migration/load error; target FixtureDocument.count decoding is not reached.
issues.reproduction_status: Static source-path proof only. No Cargo command, Rust test, or runtime reproduction was run.
issues.profile_boundary: Root Cargo.toml [profile.test] has no overflow-check override. Cargo profile documentation says test inherits dev and dev defaults overflow-checks=true. The comment names only test builds where checks are enabled.
